overloadMerges.note: Both doc syntax lines use a non-standard '-> Object' return arrow (instead of ': Object'), which the autoparse regex for the trailing return type never matches; this silently drops BOTH the params AND the return type for every overload of this command, not just the return type. Restoring params (with the '*'/object toggle collapsed into one overload per the usual pattern) and the Object return.

params.description: If passed, object is an object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable or field reference.
